mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows consecutive 3-month increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust economic expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls over consecutive 3-month intervals.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises consecutively over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it triggers expectations of central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong consumer and business demand, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and INDPRO both rise over consecutive 3-month intervals.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve typically implements accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.
